title: Listening Drill — Setting up a colour test
description: Practical demonstration. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Setting up a colour test
sections.transcript:
INSTRUCTOR: This demonstration is about setting up a colour comparison. Watch the whole process once before trying it yourself. If you start while I'm still talking, you may miss the order of the steps.

INSTRUCTOR: Get the colour cards ready. Begin by checking the desk lamp. When everything is in position, wait three minutes. It may look as though nothing is happening at first.

INSTRUCTOR: Look for stable light before moving on. don't look at the lamp directly. Leave yourself time to clear the work area so the next group can start promptly.
